title: Common providers: Taiwan
coverage: Complete for the three national carriers (which are also the three mobile network operators since the mergers of 2023) and the academic networks; cable operators and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Regional cable operators outside the three largest groups
AS numbers for 中嘉寬頻 (Homeplus) and 是方電訊 (Chief Telecom): none confirmed; AS17408, which Chief maintains, is registered to AboveNet Communications Taiwan
Websites of 台灣寬頻通訊 (TBC) and TANet (neither answered an automated check on the read date)

sources.name: National Communications Commission (NCC)
sources.terms: The site refused an automated request on the read date (HTTP 403) and its terms were not read: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Not read. It is the authority to consult for the registered telecommunications enterprises this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Taiwan
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 11 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Taiwan
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 3 of 11 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 11 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer, or that refused an automated request, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 16 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: APNIC RDAP (the registry's own record of an AS number)
sources.terms: The APNIC Whois terms allow lookups for internet operational purposes and forbid bulk copying or redistribution without consent: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read where the holder name in RIPEstat did not name the provider plainly.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: 中華電信
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile; HiNet is its internet service. AS9505 is TWGate, its international gateway.

providers.name: 台灣大哥大
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed (AS9924 is Taiwan Fixed Network). Took over Taiwan Star Telecom in December 2023.

providers.name: 遠傳電信
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed. AS9919 and AS4780 (Seednet) are its fixed arm New Century InfoComm; AS17709 came with Asia Pacific Telecom, merged in December 2023.

providers.name: 是方電訊
providers.notes: Carrier-neutral data centres, exchange and business lines.

providers.name: So-net
providers.notes: ISP; AS18182 is registered under the name Sony Network Taiwan.

providers.name: TANet
providers.notes: The academic network of the Ministry of Education.

providers.name: TWAREN
aka: 臺灣高品質學術研究網路
Taiwan Advanced Research and Education Network
國家高速網路與計算中心
